title: Plan Member Waivers on the CGM Supply Allowance, Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program
content:
# Plan member waiver on the CGM supply allowance

Patient Services Desk Reference Card, Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program, Larkfield Medical Supply.

## The policy in force

A plan member waiver is the liability notice of a commercial tier of the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program. Larkfield counts the billing units of the CGM supply allowance (A4239) that a plan member waiver must cover for the delivery of the item that can ship today when the payer is expected not to pay all of it because the delivery begins while the supply of the program's latest refill of the item is still running. The units so counted are the units the signed waiver covers.

The units the waiver covers are fixed only once the newest written order of the item stands recorded as an authorization grant.

The units the waiver covers are fixed only once the program's past-due amount, after the balance an approved payment plan on the program covers is left out, is below the tier's past-due hold minimum.

Put another way: while the records show no authorization grant resting on the newest written order of the CGM supply allowance, or show the program's past-due amount, with the balance an approved payment plan covers left out, at or above the tier's past-due hold minimum, the units the waiver covers are not yet fixed.

## The tool: `sign_plan_member_waiver_eca832b6`

### Situation of use and capability

The customer personally signs their health plan's member waiver of liability for one item on their Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program enrollment, accepting that they may owe for the stated billing units if the plan does not pay for them. One call records one signed waiver, dated today, in the enrollment's prescription and authorization file. On success the customer can see the signed waiver listed with its item and units.

### How it is invoked

`sign_plan_member_waiver_eca832b6` is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it; the representative does not run it on the customer's behalf.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `cgm_program_id` | the reference number of the customer's CGM supply program enrollment, as the representative reads it from the CGM program lookup and gives it to the customer | identifier |
| `item_code` | the HCPCS item the waiver covers | exactly one of `A4239` (the CGM supply allowance, sensors) or `E2103` (a CGM receiver or reader) |
| `notice_units` | the billing units the waiver covers | a positive integer in billing units, with no decimals |

- `cgm_program_id` identifies the enrollment the waiver is recorded on.
- `item_code` takes one of its two values and no other: `A4239` or `E2103`.
- `notice_units` is a whole number of billing units greater than zero.

### Return

A confirmation sentence naming the signed waiver's reference number (the prefix `pmw_` followed by 12 hexadecimal characters), the enrollment reference number, the item, the units covered and the signing date in YYYY-MM-DD format. The presence of the waiver reference number indicates that the waiver was signed and recorded.

### Illustration (hypothetical input)

A hypothetical call with an enrollment reference number, `item_code` `A4239` and `notice_units` <units> returns a sentence stating a waiver reference beginning `pmw_`, that enrollment, the item A4239, <units> unit(s) and the date of signing.
